description: Foundation layer that every later feature imports: the Tailwind HUD theme + global CSS + font loading (design §1), the single dummy-data source (§4), the pure logic modules (§2/§2.8/§3), the React hooks (§3), and the shared UI primitives (§3). This is self-contained and must be done first; FEAT-002/003/004 all depend on it. Grounded in the verified scaffold (tailwind theme.extend is {}, index.css has only @tailwind directives, App.jsx is a placeholder) and the locked stack in package.json.
steps: Rewrite tailwind.config.js theme.extend WHOLESALE with the design §1 block: single `hud` color group (void/panel/panel2/line/cyan/amber/green/red + hi/mid/dim text ramp folded in), mono/sans fontFamily, hud-xs/hud-sm fontSize, glow + glow-amber boxShadow (cyanSoft/amberSoft as raw hex only), grid-fine/scanlines/radial-fade backgroundImage, grid-fine backgroundSize, and all keyframes/animation (scanline, radar-sweep, glow-pulse, grid-drift, flicker, blink). Do NOT add a separate `text` color group.

Rewrite src/index.css keeping the three @tailwind directives as the first lines, then add: html { scroll-behavior:smooth; scroll-padding-top:5rem }, body { @apply bg-hud-void text-hud-mid font-sans antialiased }, cyan ::selection + thin cyan scrollbar, a @layer components block (.hud-label, .hud-corner, .glass, .text-glow using cyanSoft/amberSoft raw hex), and the @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block that neutralizes animations/transitions and sets scroll-behavior:auto. Do NOT use a CSS @import for fonts.

Edit index.html to add <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin> and the Google Fonts stylesheet <link> with display=swap for JetBrains Mono + Space Grotesk. Leave the existing <title>/<meta description> as-is (custom favicon/title are a later client step).

Create src/data/portfolio.js as a single default-exported object matching design §4 verbatim in shape (identity, hero.telemetry seeds, about, skillGroups, experience, projects, gallery, certifications, contact, nav), with the swap-in header comments and per-field guidance (image:null -> gradient placeholder alt=""; real image -> path + descriptive alt).

Create src/lib/telemetry.js: an initial-state builder from seed values and a pure telemetryReducer(state,{type:'tick',rng}) implementing the §2 contract (altitude +-0..3 clamp [380,440]; speed +-0..0.4 1-decimal clamp [10,18]; battery -1% every 5th tick floor 60; signal/gps static; tickCount++). rng defaults to Math.random, injectable for determinism; pure, no side effects.

Create src/lib/validateContact.js: pure validateContact({name,email,message}) returning {valid,errors} per §2.8 (name required trim 1..80; email required matching /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/; message required trim 10..1000; valid = no error keys).

Create src/lib/deviceTier.js: detectWebGL() (throwaway canvas, try webgl then experimental-webgl in try/catch, true only if a context is obtained) and pure computeTier({width,cores,memory,reducedMotion,webglOk}) returning {tier,dpr,parallax,rotorSpeed} per §3, with the undefined-signal guard so undefined cores/memory never downgrade on their own (only a defined number <=4 downgrades).

Create the six hooks in src/hooks/: useReducedMotion.js (matchMedia wrapper, listener cleanup), useActiveSection.js (IntersectionObserver -> active nav id), useMousePosition.js (normalized -1..1, rAF-throttled, cleanup), useDeviceTier.js (reads window.innerWidth/navigator.hardwareConcurrency/navigator.deviceMemory + useReducedMotion + detectWebGL, calls computeTier), useFocusTrap.js (focus first on activate, Tab/Shift+Tab cycle, Esc closes + restores prior focus, aria-hidden/inert on siblings), useTelemetry.js (seeds from data, 1200ms setInterval dispatching the reducer, cleared on unmount, never started under reduced motion).

Create the nine UI primitives in src/components/ui/: CornerBrackets.jsx, HudFrame.jsx, HudCard.jsx, Crosshair.jsx, TelemetryReadout.jsx, SectionHeading.jsx (mono kicker + <h2> + reveal gated by useReducedMotion), StatusChip.jsx (explicit COMPLETE->green/ACTIVE->amber/CLASSIFIED->dim + nominal/fault lookup, unknown->dim), Tag.jsx, SignalBars.jsx. Decorative ones are aria-hidden; CornerBrackets is the atomic unit reused by HudFrame/HudCard/tiles.
Run the verification build; fix any Tailwind/PostCSS errors before marking complete.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 with no PostCSS/Tailwind 'class does not exist' errors.

tailwind.config.js exposes the single `hud` color group (no separate `text` group) and all design §1 keyframes/animations; src/index.css starts with the three @tailwind directives and contains the @layer components primitives + prefers-reduced-motion block; index.html loads the two font families via <link> (no CSS @import).
src/data/portfolio.js default-exports the full §4 object shape and is importable without runtime errors.

src/lib/{telemetry,validateContact,deviceTier}.js export pure functions matching the §2/§2.8/§3 contracts (reducer clamps + battery floor; validator rules + {valid,errors}; computeTier three tiers + undefined-signal guard).
All six hooks and all nine UI primitives exist at the paths in context.json.directory_structure and import without circular-dependency or build errors.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm exit 0 with clean Tailwind/PostCSS output.

Temporarily import src/data/portfolio.js and one or two UI primitives into src/App.jsx (or run `npm run dev`) to confirm the hud theme applies (dark void background, mono/sans fonts) and primitives render brackets/labels with no console errors; revert any scratch wiring before completing.
findings:
Foundation layer complete and committed. `npm run build` exits 0 (clean Tailwind/PostCSS, no 'class does not exist'); `npm run preview` served the page with font <link>s present and hud void(#05070A)/cyan(#00E5D4) tokens emitted in the CSS. Scratch wiring in App.jsx was used for verification then reverted — App.jsx is back to the original placeholder; FEAT-004 owns the real §2 composition.

Contracts/APIs later features import:
- Data: `import data from 'src/data/portfolio.js'` (default export). Shape per §4: identity, hero.telemetry{altitude,battery,gps,signal,speed}, about{bio[],stats[]}, skillGroups[{id,title,skills[{name,level}]}], experience[{id,role,org,start,end,status,highlights[]}], projects[{id,title,status('COMPLETE'|'ACTIVE'|'CLASSIFIED'),objective,tech[],image,alt}], gallery[{id,caption,image,alt,coords}], certifications[], contact{email,socials[{label,url,handle}]}, nav[{id,label}]. All image fields are null -> render gradient/SVG placeholder with alt="".
- src/lib/telemetry.js: named exports createTelemetryState(seed)->state{...,tickCount:0} and telemetryReducer(state,{type:'tick',rng?}) (rng defaults Math.random; pure; clamps alt[380,440]/speed[10,18] 1dp, battery -1 every 5th tick floor 60, static signal/gps, tickCount++).
- src/lib/validateContact.js: named + default export validateContact({name,email,message})->{valid,errors{name?,email?,message?}} (name 1..80, email /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/, message 10..1000; error strings are user-facing copy).
- src/lib/deviceTier.js: named exports detectWebGL()->bool and computeTier({width,cores,memory,reducedMotion,webglOk})->{tier,dpr:[min,max],parallax,rotorSpeed}. Tier3 dpr[1,1] rotor0, tier2 dpr[1,1.5] rotor0.4 parallax off, tier1 dpr[1,2] rotor1 parallax on. undefined cores/memory never downgrade (only a defined number <=4 does).
- Hooks (src/hooks/, each default + named export): useReducedMotion()->bool; useActiveSection(ids[],{rootMargin?})->activeId; useMousePosition(enabled=true)->{x,y} in [-1,1]; useDeviceTier()->tier object (recomputes on resize + reduced-motion change); useFocusTrap(ref,active,onEscape) (traps Tab, Esc calls onEscape + restores focus, inert/aria-hidden siblings); useTelemetry(seed)->state (1200ms interval, cleared on unmount, never started under reduced motion).
- UI primitives (src/components/ui/, default exports): CornerBrackets({size,className}); HudFrame({label,children,className}); HudCard({children,className,...rest}); Crosshair({tracking,className}); TelemetryReadout({label,value,unit,className,decorative=true}); SectionHeading({kicker,children,id,className}) renders <h2 id> gated reveal (pass id for aria-labelledby); StatusChip({status,label,className}) lookup COMPLETE->green/ACTIVE->amber/CLASSIFIED->dim(redacted,▣)/nominal->green/fault->red, unknown->dim; Tag({children,className}); SignalBars({level,max=5,label,className}).

Notes for later steps: Tailwind uses ONE `hud` color group (text-hud-hi/-mid/-dim, bg-hud-void, border-hud-line, etc.); cyanSoft/amberSoft are NOT tokens (raw hex only). index.css provides .hud-label/.hud-corner/.glass/.text-glow utility classes + reduced-motion neutralizer. Animations available: animate-scanline/-radar-sweep/-glow-pulse/-grid-drift/flicker/blink. StrictMode stays — all effects clean up. The Three.js code-split chunk does NOT exist yet (no React.lazy import until FEAT with the 3D hero); the 142kB single JS chunk here is the pre-3D baseline.
